definitions.explanation: A small cube with different numbers of dots (1-6) on each face, used in games of chance. Typically thrown to generate random numbers.
Food cut into small cube shapes, resembling dice.

examples.japanese: サイコロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Roll the dice and move forward by the number that comes up.

examples.japanese: サイコロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧2⟦つ→つ：01004_tsu⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Roll two dice and add up the total.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧サイコロ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the daikon into cube shapes.

notes:
ALTERNATE WRITING:
・{骰子|さいころ} (kanji form, rarely used)
・Also written サイコロ in katakana

DICE TERMINOLOGY:
・サイコロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (the number/pips on a die)
・⟦{丁|ちょう}→丁：noentry⟧ (even number total)
・⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (odd number total)
・⟦ぞろ{目|め}→ぞろ目：noentry⟧ (doubles)

COMMON USES:
・⟦{双六|すごろく}→双六：07350_sugoroku⟧ (sugoroku - traditional Japanese board game)
・⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (The Game of Life)
・⟦{麻雀|マージャン}→麻雀：noentry⟧ (mahjong - for determining dealer/starting position)
・Tabletop RPGs and board games

COOKING USAGE:
・サイコロ⟦{切|ぎ}り→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (diced cut)
・サイコロ⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧ (cubed steak)
・サイコロ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut into cubes)

IDIOM:
・⟦{賽|さい}→賽：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投|な}げられた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (⟦{賽|さい}→賽：noentry⟧ is an older word for dice) - "The die is cast"

COLLOCATIONS:
・サイコロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to roll/throw dice)
・サイコロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{転|ころ}がす→転がす：02521_korogasu⟧ (to roll dice)
・サイコロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (for a number to come up)
